C0351.title: GM Hit by Credential Stuffing Attack Exposing Car Owner Personal Data
C0351.summary: From April 11 to April 29, 2022, General Motors found that attackers used credentials obtained from non-GM websites to access customer online accounts. The attackers viewed some customers' names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, usernames, and other information, and redeemed reward points from some accounts for gift cards. GM then notified affected users and required password resets.
